name: CP ALL Public Company Limited
summary: CP ALL Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates convenience stores under the 7-Eleven name to other retailers primarily in Thailand, Malaysia, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Convenience stores, Wholesale, Retail and Mall, and Other. It also operates frozen food plants and bakeries; distributes various commercial cards and tickets, and hardware and equipment; manufactures, imports, exports, distributes, and trades in food products.
